purpose: silver_online_retail_transactions cleans the bronze online_retail_ii invoice line-item export, casting numeric and temporal fields to proper types, deriving a return indicator, and dropping Airbyte capture metadata, to feed downstream sales and returns analytics.
usage: Consumers should read one row as an invoice line item keyed by invoice and stockcode, filter on is_return to separate return or cancellation lines from net sales when computing revenue, and treat customer_id as optional since guest transactions carry no customer identifier.
limitations: Exact duplicate rows (duplicate_row_rate 0.011188 across 45228 rows) are removed during dedupe; description remains nullable (null_rate 0.005041) and free-text with some non-product entries like 'Bank Charges' that were not reclassified; customer_id remains nullable at a high null_rate of 0.29778 for guest orders and was not imputed.
